Name: Grass Growth Adjuster
Author: Shockade
Description:
This mod allows you to adjust the chance for grass to spread.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
On first launch with the mod installed, the config file will be generated with a default value of 5.

Grass growth levels:
2 is gentle, a little faster than stock.
5 is manageable but much faster.
10 would start to get a little crazy.

I recommend a value between 2-5.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.33 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]For SMAPI 2.10.1 and SMAPI 3.0 ready!
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
